title: Count local steps and guidance frequency on generator runs
narrative: Nubble starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, loads the `verify_repair` durable graph (controller `ops`, store `memory`). Operators need to see how often a frontier driver was asked for advice versus how much local work ran, so they can optimize verified useful work per intervention. Tracks R-IOC-BUDGET. He walks product steps (start, answer) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^insp-ioc-08]
implementation: `GeneratorCostCounters` on `GeneratorRunRecord` exposed via `inspect().cost` (local_steps, guidance_yields, resumes, rejected_resumes).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `session.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
